body:
SESSION-HIJACK LEAD: Use four server-side opaque session classes, never one JWT reused everywhere: AccountSession; short-lived PresentationControlSession; paired DeviceSession; AudienceDisplaySession (`audience:read` only). Each has independent 128-bit CSPRNG ID, revocation and cookie on its own origin: `__Host-<name>=...; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/` (no Domain). Rotate on authentication, presentation start, pairing/role/control handoff; invalidate old ID and force old WSS closed. End/logout/revoke closes every socket immediately through revocation pubsub. Recommended bounds: 30m idle, 8h absolute, and hard expiration at presentation end + short cleanup grace. Never URL/query/fragment/localStorage/IndexedDB/log tokens.

Make WSS same-origin via reverse proxy (`console.example/ws`, `audience.example/ws`). Exact `Origin` allowlist at handshake (full string, not suffix); authenticate cookie before 101; derive subscriptions server-side—client never supplies arbitrary tenant/room/topic. Validate JSON schema/size/type, rate limit, authorize EVERY message, periodically revalidate long connections and close at auth/ACL expiry. Audience principal has no command types. Reconnect returns a role-filtered current snapshot, never raw event backlog. Do not put auth in WebSocket query strings.

Prevent CSRF/CSWSH: SameSite is defense-in-depth, plus synchronizer token on every state-changing HTTP request, exact Origin/Referer policy, Fetch Metadata reject `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site`, and no GET mutations. Prevent XSS/token riding: render STT/RAG/model/search as text (no model HTML), contextual output encoding/sanitization, strict nonce CSP + Trusted Types, no third-party JS, `object-src/base-uri/frame-ancestors 'none'`. Both origins use HSTS (only add includeSubDomains/preload after every subdomain is HTTPS), no-store private responses, COOP same-origin, CORP same-origin where applicable, Referrer-Policy no-referrer.

Hijack/race control: exactly one primary controller lease. Every mutating command carries server-issued `controller_epoch`, monotonic `command_seq`, idempotency UUID and candidate/card ID (never arbitrary audience JSON). Handoff explicitly increments epoch and invalidates old controller; stale/out-of-order/duplicate commands reject. Pair/start/end/handoff are security audit events. Do not hard-bind IP (breaks mobile); instead show active device/last-seen, alert on concurrent/geographic anomalies, provide revoke-all.

Acceptance: malicious Origin socket rejected; expired/rotated cookie cannot reconnect; audience `publish` denied; arbitrary topic denied; old controller after handoff denied; duplicate/out-of-order command denied; cross-site POST denied; session end closes all sockets; XSS corpus payload is inert; private SW/cache/log/history contain no credential/content.

Sources: https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Session_Management_Cheat_Sheet.html ; https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/WebSocket_Security_Cheat_Sheet.html ; https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Cross-Site_Request_Forgery_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html ; https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Cross_Site_Scripting_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html ; https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/Set-Cookie ; https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/Sec-Fetch-Site ; https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Content_Security_Policy_Cheat_Sheet.html
